authority: toscanini/conversational/product_events.py (the code is the authority; this document is its published contract)
purpose: The conversational event layer: product events derived EXCLUSIVELY from the run directory's persisted artifacts. Product events are NOT replacements for canonical state (directive section 9) - they are a projection of it, the same discipline as the R431 event journal applied to the directive's product vocabulary.
directive_reference: CODER 1 - DISCOVERY INTELLIGENCE / CLAUDE-LIKE PROBLEM PROCESSING, sections 9 and 10

event_types.DISCOVERY_STARTED: the run's own problem.json exists - the stated problem began the run
event_types.UNDERSTANDING_PROBLEM: PROBLEM_UNDERSTANDING.json exists - the structured interpretation was recorded (n_unknowns carried in detail)
event_types.CHECKING_PROBLEM_EXISTENCE: the PREMISE_GATE stage executed (its own recorded status)
event_types.EVIDENCE_UPDATED: the FREEZE / VERIFY stages executed; also the terminal fallback for a non-verdict terminal state
event_types.MECHANISMS_IDENTIFIED: SYNTHESIZE / MECHANISM_SPACE executed and produced a mechanism (HYPOTHESIZED - a hypothesis, never a fact)
event_types.CANDIDATES_GENERATED: a candidate exists on the envelope - explicitly 'a hypothesis until attacked'
event_types.ATTACKING_CANDIDATE: the ATTACK stage EXECUTED (non-execution statuses never emit this)
event_types.CANDIDATE_REJECTED: the RECORDED verdict says killed: attack overall=KILL, a killed lineage generation, or a REJECTED/MALFORMED_OR_FALSE_PREMISE terminal
event_types.CANDIDATE_SURVIVED: the RECORDED attack verdict is a pass (never inferred from completion - Art. X/XXVIII)
event_types.ENGINEERING_EVALUATION: the bridge report's own completed outcome
event_types.OUTCOME_RECEIVED: a REALITY_LOOP ledger event exists (PHYSICALLY_OBSERVED - only from real records)
event_types.MODEL_UPDATED: the technical state was updated from a recorded observation (causal mutation chain)
event_types.CANDIDATE_MUTATED: a lineage generation carries a causal delta / mutation reason
event_types.PACKAGE_READY: the package compiler's OWN report says complete (a stale bridge outcome cannot override it)
event_types.CLARIFICATION_REQUESTED: the one-question pause opened (the session question + the PU record)
event_types.RUN_BLOCKED: an infrastructure-class state (ERROR_*, RUN_BLOCKED_TRANSPORT, INTERRUPTED, BLOCKED/FAILED attack stage) - never a scientific verdict (Art. LXI)

event_fields.type: one of the closed vocabulary above
event_fields.message: one honest sentence derived from the artifact
event_fields.basis_ref: the EXACT persisted artifact this event derives from (envelope_*.json, PROBLEM_UNDERSTANDING.json, INVENTION_LINEAGE.json, BRIDGE_REPORT.json, PACKAGE_REPORT.json, REALITY_LOOP_LEDGER.json, final_state.json, run_manifest.json)
event_fields.epistemic_class: USER_STATED | RETRIEVED | INFERRED | HYPOTHESIZED | COMPUTED | SIMULATED | ENGINEERING_DEFINED | PHYSICALLY_OBSERVED | UNKNOWN - the class of the SOURCE artifact, never promoted (Art. XXVIII)
event_fields.timestamp: the source artifact's own recorded time when it has one

derivation_rules: Every event carries basis_ref - an event without a basis artifact is never emitted
A non-executed stage (projected to one of the six non-execution states) emits NO scientific event
ATTACK with a non-execution status can NEVER emit CANDIDATE_SURVIVED (acceptance test G: NOT_RUN is never 'survived')
An infrastructure-class attack state emits RUN_BLOCKED, never a scientific outcome (Art. LXI)
A killed lineage generation emits CANDIDATE_REJECTED (R452 killed-invention authority)
OUTCOME_RECEIVED / MODEL_UPDATED derive ONLY from the reality-loop ledger (Art. XXXVIII boundary)
PACKAGE_READY requires the package report's own complete field when a package report exists (acceptance test J)
surface: GET /api/run/{id}/product-events (owner-scoped; returns the stream with its validation problems list)
